# CocoTrip

> Korea travel planning and private transport for foreign visitors: day-by-day
> itineraries auto-written from real Korean routes, private charter vehicles with a
> driver, guided day tours, and practical travel guides. Operated by a registered
> Korean travel agency; the site is published in English, Korean, Japanese and Chinese
> at the same URLs.

Prices, cancellation terms and vehicle capacity change over time. Read them from the
linked pages rather than caching them — every quote on the site is generated from the
current pricing source. For fixed-price products (airport transfers and other flat-rate
zones), the price shown before payment is the price charged, with nothing added
afterwards. Custom charter estimates outside the flat-rate zones are estimates: if the
actual distance or duration differs from the estimate by more than ±10%, the difference
is settled after the trip as an additional charge or a partial refund — customers agree
to this on the payment screen before checkout.

## Plan a trip

- [Trip planner](https://cocotripkr.com/planner): a day-by-day Korea itinerary auto-written from your dates, party size, budget and dietary needs (halal, vegetarian, allergies), using real Korean places, subway/bus routes and walking directions.
- [Private charter](https://cocotripkr.com/charter): car and driver — airport transfers, full-day charter tours, multi-day intercity routes, concert shuttles. Quote without an account; pricing, inclusions and FAQ are on the page.
- [Guided tours](https://cocotripkr.com/tours): fixed-itinerary day tours with set departure points.

## Travel guides

- [Korea travel guides](https://cocotripkr.com/guide): written guides on food, seasons, transport, etiquette and region-specific trips. Each guide lives at `/guide/<slug>`.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Every charter vehicle comes with a driver. CocoTrip is not a self-drive rental service.
- Itineraries, quotes and availability are generated per request; there is no static price list to quote from.
- Contact: cocotripkr@gmail.com
